a.xlink:title: Free an AST node and everything it owns. NULL-safe.
Allocate an AST_WHILE node, taking ownership of cond and body. body may be NULL for an empty { }.
Human-readable name for a token kind (for error messages).
Allocate a binary operator node (AND, OR or SEQ) taking ownership of left and right....
Consume and return the next token.
Peek at the next token without consuming.
Append stage to a pipeline (taking ownership). Grows as needed.
